notes.title: Release and Onward!
notes.notes:
Toko launches in a little over a week now! Thank you everyone for your patience; Toko is now done~!

That said, we have a few things planned after release. People were interested in seeing things like Steam cards, voice acting, and more. Following release, we are going to be working on a set of Steam trading cards for Toko as well as a patch that will bump the default resolution from 720p up to a scalable resolution of 1440p! This will be a free release for everyone who got bought the game. (Please note: if space or RAM is an issue for you, then you can opt to not download this patch). 

In addition to this, we are pursuing a voice acting patch for the game. If this interests you, let us know! Voice acting is on the expensive side and our goal is to have high quality voice acting that fits each character. Understandably, if we can't achieve that goal then we'd rather not have the voice acting. That said,  we will be beginning auditions for the game very soon. There is no ETA when this patch might be out but we plan to show samples as we finalize the cast.
